title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28618v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware attention implementations, limiting their scalability. The adaptation is, however, non-trivial: edge and graph-level features must be injected into pairwise attention scores, graph masks must be respected, and dynamic edge updates remain a major source of quadratic memory usage. We propose an edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that incorporates structural information through head-wise score modulation, while updating edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism that retains attention-score dependent edge updates. This layer can be effectively implemented using PyTorch's FlexAttention. translated_title: 面向图生成的高效边感知注意力网络
translated_abstract: 图生成模型通常使用图特定的Transformer架构来联合更新节点和边特征。然而，这些架构无法直接受益于近期的硬件感知注意力实现，限制了其可扩展性。这种适配并非易事：边和图级特征必须注入成对注意力分数中，必须遵守图掩码，而动态边更新仍是二次方内存占用的主要来源。我们提出了一种用于图生成的边感知注意力层，该层通过头级分数调制融入结构信息，同时利用一种保留依赖于注意力分数的边更新的轻量级残差机制来更新边表示。该层可以借助PyTorch的FlexAttention高效实现。我们在取得与基线相近的生成质量的同时，将峰值GPU内存占用降低约65%，并大幅提升了训练（效率）……
tldr: 提出一种用于图生成的边感知注意力层，通过头级分数调制注入结构信息并以轻量残差机制更新边表示，可基于FlexAttention高效实现，在保持生成质量的同时将峰值GPU内存降低约65%并显著提升训练效率。
en_tdlr: An edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that injects structural information via head-wise score modulation and updates edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism, efficiently implemented with FlexAttention, achieving similar generation quality while reducing peak GPU memory by ~65% and substantially improving training efficiency.
